title: Weighted adversary tradeoff for quantum queries and non-collapsing measurements

standard_prerequisites.name: Standard quantum fidelity, hybrid search lower bounds and cited weighted adversary framework
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Exact imported statements and full original bibliography retained; all local purified-register and progress proofs included.

core_obligations: Construct the equivalent non-collapsing oracle representation with partial-measurement gates.
Prove fidelity and weighted progress bounds and derive the query-measurement tradeoff.
difficulty_reason: Develops an equivalent purified-register formulation of non-collapsing computation and proves a weighted adversary progress bound despite partial measurement. Query count and non-collapsing measurement count enter separately in the explicit product lower bound.

dedup.scope: Root checked complete legacy, aliases, preparation and both active lines for exclusive DOI without neighbors. Majority/parity/element-distinctness application corollaries and register support lemmas are uncounted. Different models/resources are kept explicit.
